 The Police-Inspector, Giri nagar Police Station has filed chargesheet against Accused for the offences punishable U/s.
120B, 420, 471, 448, 468 R/W/S 34 of I.P.C.

The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. Lelavathi.

The gist of the prosecution case is that the CW-1 is the owner of the house property of CW-1 situated at No.4007, Old No.770/2, Girinagar 4 th Phase and CW-1 had rented out the house to the accused No.2 and 3 on 08-02-2010.
The accused No.2 and 3 were not paying rent regularly and were giving reasons and hence CW1 insisted them to vacate the house.

The accused No.1 to 3 have criminally conspired together to fabricate a Deed of Mortgage in respect of House property of CW-1 situated at No.4007, Old No.770/2, Girinagar 4th Phase and cause wrongful loss to CW1.

It is further alleged that accused No.1 along with accused No.2 and 3 (splitup) in furtherance of their common intention forged the documents as if CW-1 had given the above said house for mortgage to accused No.1.

After creating the forged documents presented the said document as genuine documents  3  C.C.No.8526/2019 and criminally trespassed into the property of CW-1 as said above and in order to deceive the CW-1 the accused persons colluded together and fabricated the Deed of Mortgage and thus cheated CW-1 for wrongful gain.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.251/2015 came to be registered against the accused persons.

3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I. of Giri.nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid Leelvathy vs Ramadas .K Alias Ramadas on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187312612/
2 offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused were entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.
The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused persons as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

During the pendency of the case,
the accused No.2 and 3 did not turn up before court despite issuance of several process on many occasions.

The concerned police could not secure the presence of accused No.2 and 3 and hence, case was separated and the concerned IO is directed to file a splitup chargesheet against accused NO.2 and 3.
 4.

Before framing charge, an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.1 and after hearing him and the  4  C.C.No.8526/2019 prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offence was framed and same was read over to the accused No.1 in the language known to him, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In support of the case of prosecution, in spite of repeated issuance of summons and warrants the jurisdictional police failed to secure the presence of CW 1 to 12.
Hence, the prayer of Sr.APP was rejected and CW-1 to 12 were dropped.
As none of the witnesses are examined by the prosecution and no evidence against the accused No.1, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., is dispensed with.
6. I have heard the arguments of learned Sr.APP., for the prosecution and learned counsel for the accused.

Perused the Leelvathy vs Ramadas .K Alias Ramadas on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187312612/
3 materials available on record.
 7.

The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all  reasonable doubt that the accused No.1 to 3 have  criminally conspired together to fabricate a Deed of  Mortgage in respect of House property of CW-1 situated  at No.4007, Old No.770/2, Girinagar 4th Phase and  cause wrongful loss to CW1, forged the documents as if  CW-1 had given the above said house for mortgage to  accused No.1 and after creating the forged documents  presented the said document as genuine documents  5  C.C.No.8526/2019  and criminally trespassed into the property of CW-1 and  in order to deceive the CW-1 the accused persons

colluded together and fabricated the Deed of Mortgage  and thus cheated CW-1 for wrongful gain and thereby  accused have committed the offences punishable U/s.
 120B, 420, 471, 448, 468 R/W/S 34 of I.P.C.. ?
2) what order?

8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........ As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9.

The witnesses cited in the charge sheet did not appeared and lead their evidence and there are no materials against accused No.1 to 12 as Cws. 1 to 12 were not secured by the prosecution,
they were dropped.
This court issued summons, warrant and proclamation to Cws.1 to 12.
But the concerned police could not secure the presence of the witnesses in-spite of issuance of several times process by this court.
Moreover this case is of the year 2019 .
The Cws.1 to 12 may not be secured in near future days.

Hence,
prayer of Sr.APP to reissue witness summons to Cw's was rejected Leelvathy vs Ramadas .K Alias Ramadas on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187312612/
4 and Cws.1 to 12 were dropped and prosecution side evidence is taken as Nil.
Since there was no incriminating evidence against the accused, the statement of accused U/s.313 of Cr.P.C. was  6  C.C.No.8526/2019 dispensed with.
In the absence of evidence of Cws.1 to 12, there are no material to show that the accused No.1 has committed the offences punishable u/s.120B, 420, 471, 448, 468 R/W/S 34 of I.P.C..
Hence, I hold that the prosecution has utterly failed to prove the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

10. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following;
 ORDER Acting Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused No.1 is hereby acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 120B, 420, 471, 448, 468 R/W/S 34 of I.P.C..
The bail bond and surety bond of accused No.1 shall stands cancelled.
Since Case against Accused No.2 and 3 is splitup, office is hereby directed to preserve the records and property , if any for future reference.

(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on the computer and print out taken by her is verified, corrected & then pronounced by me in the Open Court dated this the 04-09-2025).
